onscreen_lines.desc: FOR INTERPRETATION SERVICES ONLY: This is for Oral Interpretation ONLY Required for any and all languages, but not limited to only Spanish. Specific need in the District is for translators in Russian, Hindu, Vietnamese, Farsi and French and possibly other languages as deemed necessary. Respondents would be needed to attend special meetings, specifically with special needs students, to interpret proceedings in accordance with federal regulations SBOE/commissioner rules and local policies and procedures. Respondents may be asked to walk with assessment personnel administering standardized testing to students and oral interpretation may be needed on a case-by-case basis.
